I decided to try this during the black friday sale when it was less a financial gamble to try a new product. I'm a driver for public transit and the nessessay dash heat to keep me warm in the winter is harshly drying to my skin in the winter. I use this after washing my face followed with the tea elixer serum and the black tea firming overnight mask after work and my skin heals quickly. The product definitely makes my skin feel healthy again. I have no negative reactions. I'm really happy to have relief. I wish I knew about Fresh years ago. It's expensive and a purchase I need to budget for. Honestly, I decided to try fresh because the eye cream had the highest review rating and I didn't want to try another product that didnt work. I'm happy with the results.

I have been a loyal Fresh customer for years, but my recent experience has been deeply disappointing. My recent order arrived with toner bottles shattered, leaving the entire package soaked and in a disgusting state. When I contacted customer service, I was told to return the undamaged items. Since the return label in the package was ruined, I had to spend extra money to print a new one at UPS. I returned the package over two weeks ago, and tracking confirms it was received by Fresh. However, I have yet to receive any response or resolution. It has now been 28 days since I placed my order, and there has been no replacement or refund. This lack of communication and accountability is completely unacceptable, especially for a closed to $470 order. I expected much better from Fresh and am extremely disappointed in this experience.
